d: the ancient king of Sardis beneath the mountain that bears his name, a broad brown-bearded Anatolian lord in a lion-crested golden diadem and purple-bordered robe, the Heraclid line's predecessor on the Lydian throne, calm eyes of a man who judged between Pan and Apollo
a young bearded Solomonic emperor in brocade shamma and gold-trimmed cape, the lion-maned headdress, anxious dark eyes of the Gragn war's eve
the last native Prince of Wales, a lean hawk-faced young lord with shoulder-length brown hair and a small forked beard, Welsh cloak over mail, proud and doomed under Edward's storm
the relentless conqueror of the north Indian plains, a hard-bitten Turkish-Afghan sultan with close beard and cold long-lidded eyes, mail under a brocade kaftan, the horseman of Delhi's vanguard
the late Judaized khagan of the Volga steppes, a wide-faced steppe lord in sable collar and silk kaftan, sabre-belt of gold plates, wary eyes on the Magyar storm's horizon
the great khagan of the steppe confederacy's height, a broad flat-cheeked Asian conqueror under the sabre-hilt crown, gold-gritted saddle leathers and stacked furs, heavy-lidded and imperious
the elder banker-statesman of Florence, bald with a hooked nose and shrewd hooded eyes, plain dark Republic robe over costly crimson, calm merchant fingers on the city's ledger
the last Yuan emperor, a young broad-faced Mongol with pale court skin and thin moustache, silk robes half-shed for flight, melancholy eyes of the Ming storm

u: A Song of Ice and Fire
d: the Lord of Highgarden, fat and red-faced with curling brown hair and a forked beard, gold-and-rose brocade straining his bulk, amiable small eyes always counting advantage

u: A Song of Ice and Fire
d: the dying Lord of Riverrun, once a robust red-grey-bearded trout lord, now gaunt and propped in furs, faded blue eyes and labored breath of the brothers' war generation

u: A Song of Ice and Fire
d: a copper-skinned horselord khal, bell-braided black hair past his waist, medallion belt and painted vest over a scarred chest, hard eyes of the khalasar's pride

u: A Song of Ice and Fire
d: the tiger-party triarch of Volantis, an aged voluptuary of the oldest Free City, jeweled silks and oiled senatorial curls over the elephant-and-tiger sash, a slaver's soft hand and a demagogue's voice

u: A Song of Ice and Fire
d: the storm lord of Shipbreaker Bay, a black-haired young peer of the marches with the Baratheon brow and laughing dark eyes, sail-cloak and silver-stag buckle of the wind-tossed mission's eve

the Corrino heir of the historian's discipline, a lean tanned young scribe-prince trained by Sardaukar drills, plain Arrakeen wool over a scholar's shoulders, level eyes that read everything and rule nothing
the Bene Gesserit Mother Superior, tall and red-haired with sharp Atreides features beneath the abbey veil, copper-toned eyes that see everyone's buttons, a smile that chooses you
a third-stage Guild Navigator, an elongated amber-fleshed prescient being folded in a tank of orange spice gas, wing-fins and fish-pale eyes that navigate folded space
a small neat man with a weasel face, pinched calculating features and pale murderer's eyes, an assassin's grace in court dress, the Emperor's dampest weapon in velvet
the small Dendro Archon, a white-haired girl with pointed ears in a green-and-white scholar's dress, wide innocent eyes of the dream wisdom, blooming feathered crown
the Cryo Archon of Snezhnaya, a tall pale empress wrapped in white-and-silver regalia, cold flawless face beneath the winter crown, gloved hands over a world of collected delusions
a decadent old-regime Mondstadt noble, powdered coiffure and wine-flushed cheeks, brocaded falcon-crest velvets, indolent eyes of the aristocracy before Vanessa's rebellion
the ancient hero-chieftain of Natlan, a sun-bronzed warrior with an ocelot-claw headdress and jaguar-pelt mantle, obsidian-edged ceremonial dress, blazing eyes of the pyro tournament's first champion
the ancient Forerunner warrior-commander, grey-blue skin on an angular crested skull, crimson plates of hard-light armor, burning eyes of the Composer's betrayal

aged San'Shyuum pontiffs of the Covenant, pale hairless heads lolling in floating chairs of gilt and gravity, crackling papal voices of the Great Journey, the damp authority of Truth, Mercy and Regret
the silver-templed UNSC fleet admiral, calm stern face with a cleft chin, dress greys and the ribbons of the Covenant war, medal-ceremony steadiness of Earth's defense
a silver-maned Legislaturalist statesman of the People's Republic era, cutaway tunic with sash and miniature medals, the upholstered confidence of the welfare-state-turned-revolution's eve
the lifelong puppet emperor, a thin pale boy-faced sovereign in black court robes and jade crown-beads, composed and sad above the warlords' courtesy
the Romulan praetor, a black-haired austere nobleman of the double planet's intrigues, dark cut-velvet robes and the praetorian seal, guarded hawk eyes of the Tal Shiar's court
the Founders' face of the Great Link, a smooth amber-skinned woman with swept-back hair and composed featureless elegance, liquid eyes of the solids' judgment
the kindlier nagus of unionized Ferenginar, large-eared and snaggle-toothed in extravagant purple robes with the glowing nagus staff, a repairman's honest grin under the Rules of Acquisition
the well-meaning Galactic Republic chancellor, a silver-blond patrician with soft hooded eyes and a florid face, white-and-gold senatorial robes, a decent man outmaneuvered by the trade wars

the ancient Grand Master of the Jedi Order, a short green-skinned sage with long pointed ears, sorrowful wise amber eyes and wisps of white hair, brown robes over a gimer-stick cane of nine centuries' patience
the fleet-controlled colony governor, grey crew-cut and jowled, CD utility uniform with governor's aiguillettes, a careful functionary's face above the marine-guarded palace of a restive colony world
the black-uniformed legion grand admiral, close-cropped bullet head and iron jaw, medal-barred tunic of the Fleet's discipline, cold Slavic eyes of the iron worlds' order
the joint US-Soviet committee's chairman, a grey patrician statesman in an old-fashioned suit with the CD sash, dry cynical eyes of the dying superpowers' detente
the knightly king of Daggerfall, a broad Breton face and chestnut beard, plate-and-brocade royal harness over a gorget, seated judgement beneath the lion banner of the Iliac Bay
the Bosmer treethane-king of Valenwood's throned glades, slender and copper-haired, an antler-crown of living branch over moss-green silks, quick woodland eyes of the green pact's forests
the Redguard king of the Alik'r, a noble dark Hammerfell face under a white turban-crown, curved sword and mail beneath desert silks, the Forebear scepter of Sentinel's last crown

the living gods of the Velothi - Vivec the golden-skinned poet-warrior under a fire-halo crown, Almalexia the sorrowful goddess-queen in regal gold, Sotha Sil the clockwork hermit in his brass mask - three faces of Morrowind's god-kings
the Ringwraith second to the Witch-king, a black-cowled shadow of kingly height, an empty hood and cold steel gauntlets, the glint of a steppe warlord's armour glimpsed within the dark
the listener-queen of the terrible bargain, white-streaked red carapace skin and long hand-membranes, regal and uncertain in warform, the Fused's howl behind her voice
the young Azish emperor, brown-skinned and slight in silk gowns and the mask of office, a scribe's soft hands and startled bright eyes beneath the federal bureaucracy's throne
the unifier-king of Alethkar, tall and black-bearded, cobalt warcoat and crown over plate, the broad Alethi face of the war of reunion's conquering hunger
the masked king of Jah Keved, a tall Veden face behind the devotaries' formal mask, layered silks and the thin patient voice of the highprinces' politics
the silver-haired queen of Kandor, slim and erect in dove-grey silks and a crown of snowdrops, a soldier-queen's calm eyes that never lost count of the Blight's distance
the Taardad Aiel clan chief, sun-dark and weathered with grey in his short-cropped hair, brown-and-gold cadin'sor, a veil-line scar across his cheek, patient iron dignity of the Three-fold Land
the aged Lord Captain Commander of the Children of the Light, gaunt weathered face under white hair, white cloak bearing the golden sunburst staff, a zealot bureaucrat's cold patience
the game-of-houses king of Cairhien, slight and pale in striped Cairhienin coats beneath the rising-sun crown, thin fingers on a game board, a courtier's smile that reaches nothing
the crystal-throne Empress of the Seanchan, a dark imperious face with hair shaved at the sides and a towering lacquered weight of braids, silver-and-sapphire silks, nails like the Nine Moons' will
the Tairen high lord, swaggering and thick-chested with waxed mustaches and oiled curls under a velvet cap, a braggart's small eyes, impossible armor and ruby spaniels
no single face - a chitin cathedral of the swarm's one will, bone-ridged carapace crowned in scything talons, ten thousand lidless eyes of the galaxies' devouring hunger
the Master of Mankind, a colossal golden-armored colossus on the Terran throne, burning psychic eyes in a weathered god-face amid cables and light, the never-dying carrion lord
the supreme overlord of Commorragh, an angular ancient Aeldari face of cruel perfect beauty, ebony-and-blade regalia on a hovering throne of thorns, eyes of forever-youthful contempt
the Fire Caste's greatest commander, slender blue-skinned and lithe in white-and-red armor with the silver crest of T'au'n, piercing violet eyes behind the mont'ka commander's visor

the Slayer King of Karak Kadrin, an enormous bare-chested dwarf with a huge orange-red mohawk crest and beard, twin Slayer tattoos over slabbed muscle, the crown worn like a grievance and the axe of doom's oath
the Phoenix King of the High Elves, slender and golden-crowned with sea-grey eyes, silver-embroidered blue robes of Lothern, the courteous poise of the maritime courts

the northern marauder-prince of the dark gods' gifts, an androgynously perfect golden face and pale hair, mirror-polished plate and a silk-lined cloak, the narcotic vanity of the dark prince's favored darling
the horned rat's screeching schemer, a gaunt grey-furred skaven with curved horns and warpstone-burned eyes, tattered grey robes over verminous scheming, whiskers twitching with failed brilliance
